rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 4 "3. Get the content folder onto your laptop": line 38 header promises "the content folder"; the chunk's only instruction (line 40: "Ask Claude to fetch `ae101-content.tar.gz` to `~/Downloads/`.") downloads a compressed archive to ~/Downloads, not a folder. Extraction into an actual directory doesn't happen until the NEXT chunk (line 63-65: "Ensure my AE101 content directory exists... Extract ~/Downloads/ae101-content.tar.gz into that AE101 content directory"). At this chunk's own scope, the header overclaims what the step delivers.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reword the header to name what this step actually does (e.g. "Download the content bundle"), or fold the extraction line into this chunk so "folder" is literally true here.
